tools.name: vrbo_reprice
tools.description: New Vrbo nightly, cleaning, and pet prices that keep host take-home the same after Vrbo's flat 12% fee (Oct 29, 2026). Rates are decimals.

tools.name: airbnb_host_only
tools.description: Airbnb price that keeps host payout the same when the split host fee (default 0.03) becomes the single host-only fee (default 0.155).

tools.name: price_match
tools.description: Direct, Airbnb, and Vrbo prices that all leave the host the same take-home per night.

tools.name: lead_window
tools.description: Days from first Vrbo contact to a direct booking, and whether it is inside the window (default 30 days, as industry reports describe Vrbo's terms).

tools.name: claim_deadlines
tools.description: Airbnb Host Damage Protection deadlines from a checkout date: ask the guest to pay within 14 days, file with Airbnb within 30 days (Terms updated Feb 5, 2026). Returns dates, days left, status, and an evidence checklist. Not legal advice.

tools.name: checkout_check
tools.description: Paste Airbnb checkout instructions. Flags tasks that go past Airbnb's simple checkout asks (gather towels, trash, turn off, lock up, return keys), such as stripping beds, laundry, dishes, vacuuming, or fees for skipped chores. Returns per-line flags with reasons, friendly rewrites, a suggested list,

tools.name: list_prompts
tools.description: List the 30 copy-paste prompts for short-term rental hosts (id, category, title, what it does, url). Optional category: listing, pricing-fees, guest-messaging, reviews, claims, turnovers-cleaners, compliance, direct-booking.

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Get the full text of one host prompt by id (from list_prompts). Fill in the [BRACKETS] before running it.
